text: Before the Deluge is a cross-regional policy and investment proposal aimed at establishing a formal central-local co-investment model for river management and flood protection infrastructure across Aotearoa New Zealand. Initiated by the Greater Wellington Regional Council, the proposal seeks to leverage existing regional schemes and targeted rates to accelerate upgrades and resilience measures for river systems, stopbanks, floodgates, and nature-based solutions. The initiative underscores the urgency of addressing flood risks exacerbated by climate change, as highlighted by the impacts of Cyclones Hale and Gabrielle.

metadata.solution_name: Before the Deluge: Building Flood Resilience in Aotearoa
